failure_analysis: The initial helper searched whole JSON only by hand-picked family terms and same-source IDs. It did not force parent manifest/source aliases into the comparison. Q189 was retrieved but manually missed; Q190, Q1290/1291 and other compressed/formula-heavy questions need source identities and lower-ranked retrieval neighbors.
